summary: HomeTrust Bancshares filed an 8-K announcing completion of its 5% stock repurchase program begun December 2025, with 870,000 shares repurchased at an average price of $44.49 per share. The Board authorized a new repurchase of up to 832,000 shares, approximately 5% of outstanding shares, purchasable in the open market or privately negotiated transactions depending on market conditions. No advisor, premium, or specific close date was disclosed. The program reflects ongoing capital return to shareholders. Watch for pace of repurchases relative to average daily volume, potential accretion impact, and whether the company completes the authorization promptly.
